scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent left two unmanaged silences exceeding 30 seconds (45s at [02:30] and 42s at [06:50]) without hold announcement or thanks.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent never restated the customer's problem statement during the call, offering only procedural replies.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent repeatedly disclaimed personal responsibility, blaming Openreach and stating line takeover issues were 'completely between you, the previous tenant, and Vodafone'.

grader.scenario: New tenancy broadband takeover blocked by outgoing tenant; bridge order processed with tenancy agreement; agent leaves two silences > 30s, fails paraphrasing, and passes blame to third parties
grader.notes: The agent processed a working line takeover bridge order backed by a newly signed tenancy agreement. However, the agent failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences > 30s (45s at [02:20] and 42s at [06:40]), failed Paraphrasing by never restating Yasmin's problem statement, and failed Took Ownership of the Problem by repeatedly disclaiming responsibility and passing blame onto Openreach and the outgoing tenant.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent left an unmanaged silence of 45 seconds at [02:30] and another of 42 seconds at [06:50] without announcing hold or thanking customer upon return.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:30] Agent: 'I completely understand how critical internet connectivity is for your psychological counseling sessions, Yasmin. Having a line takeover held up by a previous resident is extremely stressful...' - Strong empathetic acknowledgment.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never offered a restatement of the customer's line takeover conflict, proceeding directly into database queries.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [02:50] Agent: 'Well, that is completely between you, the previous tenant, and Vodafone. S-Net has nothing to do with Openreach database locks...' and [12:00] Agent: '...whatever Openreach does with the timeline is entirely their department and not my responsibility.' - Explicit disclaimer of ownership.
